sources.evidence: Texas Teen Driver Education – Behind-the-Wheel Training (7 & 7 Program) The Texas Teen Driver Education Program includes 7 hours of behind-the-wheel driving instruction and 7 hours of in-car observation, which are required components of the teen licensing process. This training helps students develop essential driving skills, including: Driver awareness and alertness Defensive driving techniques Safe vehicle operation Understanding and following Texas traffic laws Responsible driving habits and self-discipline Professional and courteous driving behavior 7 Hours of Behind-the-Wheel Driving Instruction Students receive hands-on driving experience with a certified instructor while practicing essential driving skills in real-world traffic situations. This training helps students develop confidence, improve vehicle control, and learn safe driving habits. 7 Hours of In-Car Observation The observation portion allows students to ride in the vehicle and observe other student drivers during their driving lessons. While not actively driving, students gain valuable insight by watching how different traffic situations are handled and how instructors provide guidance and feedback. PLEASE NOTE: Student must have a valid Texas Learner License/Permit before beginning behind-the-wheel training. After enrollment, the driving schedule will be sent via email. For questions or enrollment assistance, please contact our office!

sources.section: Package details: 6-Hour Online Permit Class
sources.evidence: The Adult 6-Hour Permit Class in Texas is a mandatory course for adults who fall under the age limit for a learner’s license and wish to earn their safety certificate. This class educates participants on how to safely and responsibly operate a motor vehicle, including an understanding of basic laws of the road, defensive driving strategies, and proper signage recognition. The content of the six-hour module includes topics such as drug-free driving, distracted driving awareness, and rules of the road. Participants are also provided with helpful resources such as manuals, study guides, and practice tests to aid in their learning experience. Upon successful completion of all requirements, learners will receive an official Texas driver’s license or permit from the Texas Department of Public Safety, granting them the privilege of driving on the roads of Texas.

sources.section: Package details: 6-Hour Online Permit Class
sources.evidence: The Adult 6-Hour Permit Class in Texas is a mandatory course for adults who fall under the age limit for a learner’s license and wish to earn their safety certificate. This class educates participants on how to safely and responsibly operate a motor vehicle, including an understanding of basic laws of the road, defensive driving strategies, and proper signage recognition. The content of the six-hour module includes topics such as drug-free driving, distracted driving awareness, and rules of the road. Participants are also provided with helpful resources such as manuals, study guides, and practice tests to aid in their learning experience. Upon successful completion of all requirements, learners will receive an official Texas driver’s license or permit from the Texas Department of Public Safety, granting them the privilege of driving on the roads of Texas.

sources.section: Package details: 2 hours
sources.evidence: 2-Hour Road Test Preparation & Parallel Parking Lesson This specialized 2-hour driving session is designed for students who need extra practice before taking their Texas Road Test. It is especially beneficial for international drivers, and anyone looking to improve their confidence behind the wheel. If you feel you’re about 90% ready for your driving test, this course can help you identify and correct the small mistakes that often lead to point deductions or test failure. Our instructors will evaluate your driving skills, provide constructive feedback, and help you build the confidence needed to successfully pass your road test. PLEASE NOTE: MUST HAVE A VALID LEARNER LICENSE/PERMIT

observations.package_description: 2-Hour Road Test Preparation & Parallel Parking Lesson This specialized 2-hour driving session is designed for students who need extra practice before taking their Texas Road Test. It is especially beneficial for international drivers, and anyone looking to improve their confidence behind the wheel. If you feel you’re about 90% ready for your driving test, this course can help you identify and correct the small mistakes that often lead to point deductions or test failure. Our instructors will evaluate your driving skills, provide constructive feedback, and help you build the confidence needed to successfully pass your road test. PLEASE NOTE: MUST HAVE A VALID LEARNER LICENSE/PERMIT

sources.evidence: Texas Teen Driver Education – Behind-the-Wheel Training (7 & 7 Program) The Texas Teen Driver Education Program includes 7 hours of behind-the-wheel driving instruction and 7 hours of in-car observation, which are required components of the teen licensing process. This training helps students develop essential driving skills, including: Driver awareness and alertness Defensive driving techniques Safe vehicle operation Understanding and following Texas traffic laws Responsible driving habits and self-discipline Professional and courteous driving behavior 7 Hours of Behind-the-Wheel Driving Instruction Students receive hands-on driving experience with a certified instructor while practicing essential driving skills in real-world traffic situations. This training helps students develop confidence, improve vehicle control, and learn safe driving habits. 7 Hours of In-Car Observation The observation portion allows students to ride in the vehicle and observe other student drivers during their driving lessons. While not actively driving, students gain valuable insight by watching how different traffic situations are handled and how instructors provide guidance and feedback. PLEASE NOTE: Student must have a valid Texas Learner License/Permit before beginning behind-the-wheel training. After enrollment, the driving schedule will be sent via email. For questions or enrollment assistance, please contact our office!

sources.section: Package details: 6-Hour Online Permit Class
sources.evidence: The Adult 6-Hour Permit Class in Texas is a mandatory course for adults who fall under the age limit for a learner’s license and wish to earn their safety certificate. This class educates participants on how to safely and responsibly operate a motor vehicle, including an understanding of basic laws of the road, defensive driving strategies, and proper signage recognition. The content of the six-hour module includes topics such as drug-free driving, distracted driving awareness, and rules of the road. Participants are also provided with helpful resources such as manuals, study guides, and practice tests to aid in their learning experience. Upon successful completion of all requirements, learners will receive an official Texas driver’s license or permit from the Texas Department of Public Safety, granting them the privilege of driving on the roads of Texas.

faqs.question: What Makes a Good Driving School in Texas?
faqs.answer: Three Clear Standards A good driving school in Texas meets three clear standards: it holds active TDLR certification, its instructors are individually licensed (not just the school itself), and it teaches students to the actual DPS road test criteria — not just to pass a test, but to drive safely once the license is in their wallet. The TDLR (Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation) is the state agency that licenses and oversees all Texas driving schools. A school without TDLR certification cannot legally provide driver education in Texas or issue the DE-964 certificate that teen drivers need to apply for a license. Always confirm this before enrolling. Active TDLR certification Individually licensed instructors Actual DPS road test criteria

faqs.question: Who is required to take ITAD?
faqs.answer: Any applicant who has taken a 6 hour Adult Driver Education Course and was issued an ADE-1317 Certificate must view the ITAD program and receive a completion certificate before the drive test will be administered. The certificate must be dated within 90 days of the drive test. licensing_guidance.content: The TDLR (Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation) is the state agency that licenses and oversees all Texas driving schools. Always confirm this before enrolling.

licensing_guidance.content: The Adult 6-Hour Permit Class in Texas is a mandatory course for adults who fall under the age limit for a learner’s license and wish to earn their safety certificate. This class educates participants on how to safely and responsibly operate a motor vehicle, including an understanding of basic laws of the road, defensive driving strategies, and proper signage recognition. The content of the six-hour module includes topics such as drug-free driving, distracted driving awareness, and rules of the road. Participants are also provided with helpful resources such as manuals, study guides, and practice tests to aid in their learning experience. Upon successful completion of all requirements, learners will receive an official Texas driver’s license or permit from the Texas Department of Public Safety, granting them the privilege of driving on the roads of Texas.

facts.content: Any applicant who has taken a 6 hour Adult Driver Education Course and was issued an ADE-1317 Certificate must view the ITAD program and receive a completion certificate before the drive test will be administered. The certificate must be dated within 90 days of the drive test. Additionally, applicants ages 18-24 who have been issued a DE-964 showing completion of a Teen Driver Education course (24 hours classroom, 44 hours behind the wheel) are also required to watch the 2 hour ITTD video.

facts.content: The Adult 6-Hour Permit Class in Texas is a mandatory course for adults who fall under the age limit for a learner’s license and wish to earn their safety certificate. This class educates participants on how to safely and responsibly operate a motor vehicle, including an understanding of basic laws of the road, defensive driving strategies, and proper signage recognition. The content of the six-hour module includes topics such as drug-free driving, distracted driving awareness, and rules of the road. Participants are also provided with helpful resources such as manuals, study guides, and practice tests to aid in their learning experience. Upon successful completion of all requirements, learners will receive an official Texas driver’s license or permit from the Texas Department of Public Safety, granting them the privilege of driving on the roads of Texas.

sources.section: Package details: 24 Hr Classroom + Driving Package
sources.evidence: The 24-Hour Classroom, 7-Hour Driving, and 7-Hour Observation Course in Texas is designed to provide potential drivers with the necessary knowledge and skills required to safely operate a motor vehicle. 24 Hours of Classroom Instruction: The classroom portion covers essential driving concepts, including: Texas traffic laws and regulations Road signs, signals, and pavement markings Defensive driving techniques Safe vehicle operation Driver responsibility and decision-making Hazard recognition and accident prevention Highway and city driving strategies Weather and road condition awareness Construction zones and work-area safety Risk management and safe driving habits 7 Hours of Behind-the-Wheel Driving Instruction Students receive hands-on driving experience with a certified instructor while practicing essential driving skills in real-world traffic situations. This training helps students develop confidence, improve vehicle control, and learn safe driving habits. 7 Hours of In-Car Observation The observation portion allows students to ride in the vehicle and observe other student drivers during their driving lessons. While not actively driving, students gain valuable insight by watching how different traffic situations are handled and how instructors provide guidance and feedback.

sources.section: Package details: Behind the Wheel Only (7 & 7)
sources.evidence: Texas Teen Driver Education – Behind-the-Wheel Training (7 & 7 Program) The Texas Teen Driver Education Program includes 7 hours of behind-the-wheel driving instruction and 7 hours of in-car observation, which are required components of the teen licensing process. This training helps students develop essential driving skills, including: Driver awareness and alertness Defensive driving techniques Safe vehicle operation Understanding and following Texas traffic laws Responsible driving habits and self-discipline Professional and courteous driving behavior 7 Hours of Behind-the-Wheel Driving Instruction Students receive hands-on driving experience with a certified instructor while practicing essential driving skills in real-world traffic situations. This training helps students develop confidence, improve vehicle control, and learn safe driving habits. 7 Hours of In-Car Observation The observation portion allows students to ride in the vehicle and observe other student drivers during their driving lessons. While not actively driving, students gain valuable insight by watching how different traffic situations are handled and how instructors provide guidance and feedback. PLEASE NOTE: Student must have a valid Texas Learner License/Permit before beginning behind-the-wheel training. After enrollment, the driving schedule will be sent via email. For questions or enrollment assistance, please contact our office!
